## Description


#### What type of PR is this?
/kind bug
/kind flake


#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Increases baseline Prometheus e2e waits to `LongTimeout` to account for slow ServiceMonitor/config propagation.

xref: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/12123#issuecomment-4689642265

<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Three timeout constants in a Prometheus baseline e2e test were updated from `util.MediumTimeout` to `util.LongTimeout` across target discovery, metric scraping, and workload admission metric assertions to reduce test flakiness in CI environments.

## Changes

**Prometheus e2e test flake fixes**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Prometheus assertion timeout adjustments** <br> `test/e2e/singlecluster/baseline/prometheus_test.go`|Target discovery health check (line 55), kueue_build_info PromQL scrape (line 67), and admitted workload admission metrics assertions (line 126) now use `util.LongTimeout` instead of `util.MediumTimeout` to accommodate slower metric availability in CI environments.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12170](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12170): Both PRs address flaky Prometheus e2e tests by increasing timeout values from `util.MediumTimeout` to `util.LongTimeout` while waiting for Prometheus target and metrics discovery.
